evaluation: system evaluation, separate from algorithm comparison

sfs_definition.name: Ground-truth System Fidelity Score (SFS)
sfs_definition.formula: 0.35 * Restoration accuracy + 0.25 * SSIM + 0.15 * Recall + 0.15 * Specificity + 0.10 * IoU
sfs_definition.inputs: Clean source image and synthetic ground-truth damage mask; the separately predicted detector mask is used for Recall, Specificity, and IoU.
component_rationale: Restoration accuracy (35%): largest single weight; 60% of this component is the fraction of damaged grayscale pixels reconstructed within 12 intensity levels of the clean source, and 40% is the fraction of undamaged pixels preserved within that tolerance.
SSIM (25%): clean-region structural similarity against the clean source, using the 0-255 image range.
Recall (15%): sensitivity to ground-truth damaged pixels.
Specificity (15%): one minus the false-positive rate on ground-truth clean pixels, balancing missed damage against false alarms.
IoU (10%): spatial overlap of predicted and ground-truth damage regions, penalizing both false positives and false negatives.
sfs_definition.aggregation: Calculate every component and SFS per synthetic damage case, then report the unweighted arithmetic mean across cases. The separately reported pooled IoU aggregates pixels globally.
sfs_definition.interpretation: Weights are project-defined and not empirically calibrated. SFS is an overall system composite; without expert symmetry labels it is not a validated measure of symmetry fidelity. The 95.00% value is a project target, not an independently validated threshold.

classification.warning: The checkpoint was trained using the repository dataset and contains no split or fit history. These results are in-sample diagnostics, not test/generalization accuracy.

fit_diagnostics.reason: No independent held-out set was supplied and the checkpoint does not include train/validation loss or accuracy history.

wallpaper_group.ground_truth_warning: Uses group strings in cultural_data.py; treat as provisional metadata, not expert-verified reference annotations.

methodology_limits: Classification on the repository dataset is resubstitution only.
Wallpaper-group agreement uses unverified cultural_data.py labels.
Detector and restoration tests use six synthetic disk, scratch, and tear variants.
The detector's dark-pixel threshold is calibrated to the generated synthetic mark intensities; results do not establish sensitivity to naturally occurring or differently colored damage.
SFS component weights are project-defined rather than empirically calibrated.
A below-target SFS reflects the weighted contribution of all components; restoration accuracy and IoU are inspected separately.
The 95.00% SFS target is project-defined and has not been independently validated.
Synthetic results do not establish performance on naturally damaged textiles.
